goal: Compare cold QNN session readiness from source ONNX against external precompiled QNN EPContext reload for a freshly validated 0024 reconstruction derivative of the accepted Pocket canonical-v2 fixed-Alba cache512 route.

comparison.arm_a: Eight source ONNX graphs; QNN compilation occurs inside measured session creation.
comparison.arm_b: Eight non-embedded EPContext ONNX descriptors plus external QNN context binaries; offline generation cost is reported separately and excluded from cold reload setup.

route.relationship_to_0014: Same pinned learned source/config/input contract and canonical ABI, but raw reconstructed ONNX hashes differ. Never label as the exact 0014 graph set; fresh QNN/E2E/audio validation is required.
route.voice: official pinned fixed Alba state; not voice cloning

reconstruction_amendment.first_divergence: Controlled ONNX serialization before 0024 specialization: used base files match committed byte sizes but not SHA-256.

required_gates: Reconstruct and hash-check all eight canonical derivatives.
Generate one external context and reload in a fresh isolated process with source ONNX absent, fallback disabled, and QNN-only profile events.
Repeat generation and isolated reload proof for all eight sessions.
Run complete structurally valid E2E audio for both arms.
Collect at least three fresh cold processes per arm; each benchmark process creates sessions once, runs one first complete generation and at least five warm generations with full state reset.
Collect physical provider/RPC/accelerator/cycle/HVX proof and report setup delta without a minimum speedup gate.

quality.new_wav_policy: Byte-identical accepted output may retain its exact bound verdict; any byte-different WAV is descriptive and not_reviewed until Moritz reviews that exact hash. Numerical or waveform differences are not automatic blockers.

phone.lock: actual nonblocking flock on artifacts/locks/phone.lock with lock FD closed in ADB children
phone.staging: unique /data/local/tmp/experiment-0024-* root, scoped evidence pull, verified cleanup
